Tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0, see ../TESSERACT-LICENSE.md), served from here so reading a photo on
the Log screen makes no request to anyone else's server. Loaded only when "Read a photo" is used.
- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js        npm tesseract.js@5.1.1/dist
- core/tesseract-core-*-lstm.wasm.js     npm tesseract.js-core@5.1.1 (Apache-2.0)
- lang/eng.traineddata.gz                npm @tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0/4.0.0_best_int (Apache-2.0)
